chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But upon those who take him as their master.
ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority (*sulṭān*) is not absolute over all believers but is conditional upon their choice to ally with him, a concept rooted in the principle of *Ikhtiyār* (free will). This distinction underscores the Shia theological view that while Satan can influence those who follow his whispers, he holds no coercive power over the *Aṣfiyāʾ* (God's chosen ones) who remain steadfast in faith. The narration serves to encourage believers by affirming their agency in overcoming spiritual trials through conscious adherence to divine guidance.
